purpose: Freeze one unused false-stand-down case and one unused restraint control after the v2 development contract but before prospective request previews or any provider validation.

frozen_source_first_target.unresolved_matter: The grant-funded installation decision does not settle who will fund, own, and sustain the recurring deployment crews, storage route, training, shuttle staffing, incident support, and after-action capacity on which the barrier's real service depends after installation attention recedes.
frozen_source_first_target.reopen_condition: Continued reliance on the installed barrier should reopen the operating-capability premise if exercises, real incidents, staffing budgets, shuttle availability, or recurring readiness work show that the city cannot sustain the capabilities assumed by the authorization.
frozen_source_first_target.cross_thread_relationship: The current six-block installation position is operationally bounded, but its claimed protection depends on a longer-lived city capability whose recurring ownership and funding remain outside the grant-timed procurement decision.

pass_dimensions.material_pressure_recovered: At least one admitted uncertainty record materially recovers the recurring ownership, funding, or sustainable operating-capability gap without inventing an outside fact.
pass_dimensions.evidence_precision: Every admitted record cites exact aliases that support its meaning and modal force, including the distinction between grant-funded installation and city-owned operating work.
pass_dimensions.role_placement: The adopted installation position, its unresolved recurring capability, and any event that would reopen reliance remain separately inspectable.
pass_dimensions.relationship_fidelity: Any relationship uses exact admitted IDs and explains how the operating dependency limits the current position without paraphrasing either endpoint.

frozen_source_first_target.restraint_expectation: No distinct unresolved or reopen record is expected merely because the component redesign choice is deferred: the current position explicitly funds a shared interface and validation specification, requests parallel implementations, preserves competition, counts support work, tests recovery, and assigns the decision to a fixed twelve-month review.
frozen_source_first_target.existing_reopen_structure: Quality thresholds, support cost, buffer usability, redesign progress, demonstrated recovery, fixed reviews, exit from a nominal backup, and the component transition are already represented as qualification, operating evidence, or decision criteria.
frozen_source_first_target.cross_thread_relationship: If no genuinely distinct uncertainty survives beyond the explicit redesign and review structure, the relationship reader should complete with zero instead of converting the qualification or scheduled review into another relationship.

pass_dimensions.false_positive_restraint: An explicitly deferred redesign decision, fixed review, threshold, recovery exercise, support ledger, or already represented qualification does not automatically become a new unresolved matter or reopen condition.
pass_dimensions.evidence_precision: Any non-zero record must cite exact evidence for a genuinely distinct remaining matter rather than restating the transition trade-off or review plan.
pass_dimensions.relationship_restraint: The relationship reader may complete with zero and does not invent a relation merely because current, qualification, and review records coexist.

non_claims: This holdout uses polished simulated reliability conversations, not genuine real-user evidence.
The older diagnostic review informed case selection, but the frozen detailed target is never provider input.
A two-case result cannot select a production model, prove reliability, or authorize integration.
A schema-valid record remains a candidate until source-first semantic review.
